Service: Electrical

Problem:
MCB keeps tripping

Possible Causes:
Overload, short circuit, faulty appliance, or wiring fault.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Disconnect recently added appliances and avoid repeatedly resetting a tripping breaker. Have an electrician inspect the circuit if it trips again.

Relevant Service:
MCB / Fuse Fixing

Service: Electrical

Problem:
Lights are flickering

Possible Causes:
Loose connection, overloaded circuit, failing lamp, or supply issue.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Switch off the affected circuit if there is heat/sparking and arrange professional inspection.

Relevant Service:
Electrical inspection / wiring repair

Service: Electrical

Problem:
Socket is not working

Possible Causes:
Tripped breaker, loose connection, damaged socket, or wiring fault.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Check the relevant breaker once. Do not open live electrical fittings; use a qualified electrician for diagnosis.

Relevant Service:
Electrical repair

Service: Electrical

Problem:
Switch or socket feels hot

Possible Causes:
Loose connection, overload, damaged component, or wiring issue.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Stop using the fitting and switch off the circuit if safe. Arrange prompt electrician inspection.

Relevant Service:
Electrical inspection

Service: Electrical

Problem:
Burning smell or sparks

Possible Causes:
Electrical fault, damaged insulation, loose connection, or overloaded fitting.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Turn off power to the affected circuit if safe and seek professional electrical service. Do not continue using it.

Relevant Service:
Electrical inspection / repair

Service: Electrical

Problem:
Fan not working

Possible Causes:
Power/switch issue, capacitor, regulator, wiring, or motor fault.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Check power availability; further diagnosis and component replacement should be done by an electrician.

Relevant Service:
Fan repair

Service: Electrical

Problem:
Fan runs slowly

Possible Causes:
Weak capacitor, low voltage, mechanical resistance, or motor issue.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Have the fan and capacitor inspected rather than replacing parts blindly.

Relevant Service:
Fan repair

Service: Electrical

Problem:
Geyser not heating

Possible Causes:
Power supply, thermostat, heating element, or wiring issue.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Switch off power before any inspection. A technician should test the heating circuit and components.

Relevant Service:
Geyser installation/repair

Service: Electrical

Problem:
Tube light not working

Possible Causes:
Lamp, starter/driver, holder, ballast, or wiring fault.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Check the lamp only when power is off; use an electrician for wiring or fixture faults.

Relevant Service:
Tube Light Fixing

Service: Electrical

Problem:
Door bell not working

Possible Causes:
Power supply, switch, wiring, transformer, or bell unit fault.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Check the switch/breaker; electrician can test the low-voltage circuit and unit.

Relevant Service:
Door Bell Installation/repair

Service: Electrical

Problem:
TV has no power after installation

Possible Causes:
Power outlet, plug, cable, mounting/installation connection, or device fault.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Check outlet and connections without opening the TV. Professional inspection is appropriate for wiring issues.

Relevant Service:
Television Installation

Service: Electrical

Problem:
MCB/fuse replacement needed

Possible Causes:
Repeated failure may indicate an underlying overload or fault rather than only a bad fuse/MCB.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Do not simply replace repeatedly; identify the cause with professional inspection.

Relevant Service:
MCB / Fuse Fixing

Service: Plumbing

Problem:
Tap / faucet is leaking

Possible Causes:
Worn washer, damaged cartridge, loose connection, or seal failure.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Shut the tap/supply if leakage is severe; inspect washer/cartridge and replace damaged components.

Relevant Service:
Tap Washer / Jumper; Angle Cock

Service: Plumbing

Problem:
Water dripping after tap is closed

Possible Causes:
Worn washer/cartridge or damaged valve seat.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Replace the worn internal component; persistent leakage needs plumber inspection.

Relevant Service:
Tap Washer / Jumper

Service: Plumbing

Problem:
Drain is blocked

Possible Causes:
Accumulated debris, grease, hair, or blockage in the pipe/trap.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Remove accessible debris and avoid unsafe chemical mixing. Persistent blockage may require professional cleaning.

Relevant Service:
Drain / trap cleaning

Service: Plumbing

Problem:
Low water pressure

Possible Causes:
Partially closed valve, clogged aerator/filter, pipe restriction, or supply issue.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Check accessible valves/aerators. If pressure remains low, inspect the plumbing system.

Relevant Service:
Pipeline Fixing / inspection

Service: Plumbing

Problem:
Wash basin is leaking

Possible Causes:
Loose connection, worn seal, trap/pipe issue, or damaged fitting.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Identify the leaking joint and replace the failed seal/fitting; professional inspection may be needed.

Relevant Service:
Wash Basin Installation / Pipeline Fixing

Service: Plumbing

Problem:
Water tank leaking

Possible Causes:
Cracked tank, faulty outlet, loose fitting, or pipe connection.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Isolate water supply if necessary and inspect tank and connections.

Relevant Service:
Water Tank Installation

Service: Plumbing

Problem:
Toilet is leaking

Possible Causes:
Worn seal, flush component, closet bend, or connection issue.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Stop the leak at the supply if needed and inspect the flush/connection components.

Relevant Service:
Western Commode / Closet Bend repair

Service: Plumbing

Problem:
Toilet is not flushing properly

Possible Causes:
Blocked trap, faulty flush mechanism, poor water supply, or siphon issue.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Check water supply and flush mechanism; blockage or component failure may require a plumber.

Relevant Service:
Western Commode service

Service: Plumbing

Problem:
Shower has weak flow

Possible Causes:
Blocked shower head, low supply pressure, valve restriction, or pipe issue.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Clean accessible shower head and check supply; persistent low flow requires inspection.

Relevant Service:
Shower Fitting

Service: Plumbing

Problem:
Water is backing up in bathroom

Possible Causes:
Blocked drain/trap or restricted waste line.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Stop adding water and arrange drain inspection/cleaning; pressure-machine cleaning may be required.

Relevant Service:
Water Blockage / Nani Trap Cleaning

Service: Plumbing

Problem:
Pipe connection is leaking

Possible Causes:
Loose joint, failed washer/seal, cracked fitting, or pipe damage.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Turn off the relevant water supply and repair/replace the faulty connection.

Relevant Service:
Pipeline Fixing / Pipe Fitting

Service: Plumbing

Problem:
Wall has damp patch near bathroom

Possible Causes:
Concealed plumbing leak, failed waterproofing, external seepage, or condensation.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Identify and fix the moisture source before repainting; concealed leaks require professional inspection.

Relevant Service:
Leakage Repair / waterproofing-related inspection

Service: AC Technician

Problem:
AC is running but not cooling

Possible Causes:
Dirty filter/coil, restricted airflow, low refrigerant, thermostat/sensor issue, or component fault.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Start with filter/coil inspection and cleaning. If cooling remains poor, have refrigerant and components professionally checked.

Relevant Service:
Regular Service; Deep Chemical Wash; Gas Refill; Component Repair

Service: AC Technician

Problem:
AC leaking water indoors

Possible Causes:
Clogged condensate drain, frozen evaporator coil from restricted airflow/low refrigerant, or damaged drain pan.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Stop the source of water if necessary and arrange drain/coil inspection. Do not ignore recurring leakage.

Relevant Service:
Regular Service / repair

Service: AC Technician

Problem:
AC making loud or unusual noise

Possible Causes:
Indoor/outdoor fan issue, loose component, motor problem, or compressor/component fault.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Turn off the unit if the noise is severe and arrange technician diagnosis.

Relevant Service:
Component Repair / Fan Motor Replacement

Service: AC Technician

Problem:
AC has weak airflow

Possible Causes:
Dirty filter/coil, blocked airflow path, fan problem, or duct/installation issue.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Clean accessible filter and arrange professional service if airflow remains weak.

Relevant Service:
Regular Service / Deep Chemical Wash

Problem:
AC freezes or develops ice

Possible Causes:
Restricted airflow, dirty filter/coil, or low refrigerant can contribute.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Turn off cooling and allow ice to melt; technician should identify the underlying cause before restarting normal operation.

Relevant Service:
Regular Service / Gas Refill

Problem:
AC gas/refrigerant may be low

Possible Causes:
Leakage or insufficient refrigerant charge can reduce cooling.

Recommended Solution / Action:
A technician should check for leakage and refrigerant pressure rather than simply adding gas repeatedly.

Relevant Service:
Gas Refill

Service: AC Technician

Problem:
AC outdoor unit not running

Possible Causes:
Power supply, electrical control, capacitor, fan/compressor or other component issue.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Check the dedicated power supply if safe; component diagnosis should be performed by a technician.

Relevant Service:
PCB Repair / Component Repair

Service: AC Technician

Problem:
AC turns on and off frequently

Possible Causes:
Thermostat/sensor issue, airflow restriction, incorrect sizing, or system fault.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Check filter/airflow and arrange technician diagnosis if cycling continues.

Relevant Service:
Regular Service / Component Repair

Service: AC Technician

Problem:
AC has bad smell

Possible Causes:
Dirty filter/coil, moisture, drain issue, or microbial buildup.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Clean/inspect filters and indoor components; persistent odor requires professional servicing.

Relevant Service:
Regular Service / Deep Chemical Wash

Service: AC Technician

Problem:
AC remote not controlling unit

Possible Causes:
Weak batteries, remote issue, sensor issue, or power/control fault.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Replace batteries and test; if the unit still does not respond, arrange service inspection.

Relevant Service:
AC Service

Service: Carpentry

Problem:
Door is sagging or not closing smoothly

Possible Causes:
Loose/worn hinges, misalignment, or frame movement.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Inspect and tighten/replace hinges and realign the door as required.

Relevant Service:
New Hinges Fitting / Door Repair

Service: Carpentry

Problem:
Door hinge is squeaking

Possible Causes:
Dry, rusty, or worn hinge hardware.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Lubrication can help minor squeaking; worn hinges should be serviced or replaced.

Relevant Service:
Hinges

Service: Carpentry

Problem:
Door hinge is loose

Possible Causes:
Stripped screw holes or loose fasteners.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Secure the hinge appropriately; damaged mounting points may need professional repair.

Relevant Service:
Hinges / Door Repair

Service: Carpentry

Problem:
Door lock is difficult to operate

Possible Causes:
Misalignment, worn lock, loose hardware, or latch issue.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Check alignment and hardware; replace/repair the lock if worn.

Relevant Service:
Cylindrical Lock / Latch Fitting

Service: Carpentry

Problem:
Drawer is difficult to open

Possible Causes:
Damaged/misaligned channel, debris, swelling, or loose drawer components.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Inspect the channel and alignment; replace damaged channel hardware if required.

Relevant Service:
Channel Fitting In Drawer

Service: Carpentry

Problem:
Drawer door is loose/damaged

Possible Causes:
Loose fasteners, damaged board, or hinge/fitting problem.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Tighten or repair fittings; replace damaged parts where necessary.

Relevant Service:
Drawer Door Work

Service: Carpentry

Problem:
Window/door mesh is damaged

Possible Causes:
Torn or detached mesh/frame.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Replace the damaged mesh and secure it to the frame.

Relevant Service:
Jaali Replacement

Service: Carpentry

Problem:
Curtain rod is loose

Possible Causes:
Weak fixing, unsuitable anchor, or damaged mounting point.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Refix with appropriate anchors and ensure the wall can support the load.

Relevant Service:
Curtain Rod Placement

Service: Carpentry

Problem:
Furniture lock/latch is broken

Possible Causes:
Worn or damaged lock/latch mechanism.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Replace or refit the appropriate lock/latch.

Relevant Service:
Latch / Furniture Lock Fitting

Service: Carpentry

Problem:
Minor bed/furniture repair needed

Possible Causes:
Loose joints, damaged fittings, or wear from use.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Inspect joints and hardware; repair or refit affected components.

Relevant Service:
Bed Repair / Furniture repair

Service: Painting

Problem:
Paint is peeling

Possible Causes:
Poor adhesion, dampness, contamination, incompatible coats, or poor surface preparation.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Remove loose paint, correct the moisture/surface problem, prepare the surface, prime where appropriate, then repaint.

Relevant Service:
Painting / waterproofing-related inspection

Service: Painting

Problem:
Paint is blistering/bubbling

Possible Causes:
Trapped moisture/gases, damp wall, thick coating, or insufficient drying.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Identify and fix the moisture source, remove damaged coating, allow the surface to dry, and repaint correctly.

Relevant Service:
Painting / waterproofing-related inspection

Service: Painting

Problem:
White powder appears on wall (efflorescence)

Possible Causes:
Moisture carries soluble salts to the surface.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Eliminate the moisture source, clean/prepare the surface, and use an appropriate coating system after it is dry.

Relevant Service:
Painting / waterproofing-related inspection

Service: Painting

Problem:
Wall has damp patches

Possible Causes:
Plumbing leak, rain/external seepage, terrace issue, condensation, or waterproofing failure.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Find and repair the moisture source before painting; repainting alone may not solve recurrence.

Relevant Service:
Painting / leakage repair

Service: Painting

Problem:
Wall has mould/fungal growth

Possible Causes:
Persistent moisture, condensation, or poor ventilation.

Recommended Solution / Action:
Address moisture/ventilation first, clean the affected surface safely, then restore the coating system.

Relevant Service:
Painting / moisture inspection
